claim: Hotel Madame Reve (Paris, 1st arr.) occupies the grand Haussmannian Louvre Post Office (Hotel des Postes, inaugurated 1888, closed 2015), restored by Laurent Taieb with designer Andree Putman influence, with Eiffel Tower rooftop views.
quote: the Louvre Post Office closed in 2015... reopened as the spectacular Madame Reve. Inaugurated on July 14, 1888, the Hotel des Postes de Paris was a symbol of Paris's new city center

claim: Hotel Madame Reve holds One Michelin Key, awarded to hotels offering a very special stay.
quote: One Michelin Key is awarded to hotels that offer a very special stay

claim: Maison Proust in the Marais (3rd) is a Belle Epoque gem designed by Jacques Garcia with tapestries, woodwork and rooms themed around literary figures; rates from about €870/night.
quote: Maison Proust - Marais (3rd) Belle Epoque gem with "tapestries, lighting, woodwork" by Jacques Garcia. Rooms themed around literary figures. €870+

claim: Le Pavillon de la Reine sits behind an ivy-clad facade on Place des Vosges in the Marais with period antiques and fireplaces; rates roughly €350-€1,000+.
quote: Le Pavillon de la Reine - Marais (3rd) Ivy-clad facade on Place des Vosges with "period details - antiques, fireplaces, rich fabrics." ... €350-€1,000+

claim: Chateau Voltaire (Paris 1st) offers 32 rooms with Gothic details and fringed velvet plus a stone-clad spa with private pool, near the Opera; rates from about €520.
quote: Chateau Voltaire - 1st Arrondissement Gothic details and fringed velvet in 32 rooms near Opera. Stone-clad spa with private pool. €520+

claim: Claridge's in Mayfair is a Three Michelin Key Art Deco landmark dating to 1856, known for its chequerboard marble floor and chandeliers; rates from about £840/night.
quote: Claridge's, Mayfair - Historic Art Deco landmark since 1856 ... "gleaming chequerboard marble floor, cascading chandeliers" and rooftop spa - Price: From £840/night

claim: Raffles at The OWO (Whitehall) is a Three Michelin Key historic conversion of the former Old War Office with nine restaurants; rates from about £660/night.
quote: Raffles at The OWO, Whitehall - Historic conversion of former Old War Office ... Nine restaurants including three by chef Mauro Colagreco; 20-metre pool - Price: From £660/night

claim: The Savoy on the Strand was Britain's first luxury hotel, on a Thames-side site, home to the celebrated Beaufort Bar; rates from about £570/night.
quote: The Savoy, Strand - Historic Thames-side location ... First luxury hotel in Britain; celebrated Beaufort Bar - Price: From £570/night

claim: NoMad London (Covent Garden) is a sensitive conversion by EPR of the Grade II-listed Bow Street Magistrates' Court and police station - which once held defendants including Oscar Wilde - into a 91-room, 16-suite hotel designed by Roman and Williams, with original cells now a police museum.
quote: EPR's sensitive conversion ... transformed the Grade II listed building into a luxury lifestyle hotel and Police Museum ... housed many famous defendants such as Oscar Wilde ... a wing of original police cells has been converted into the Bow Street Police Museum

claim: Pulitzer Amsterdam is the city's largest canal-house hotel, set within 25 interlinked 17th- and 18th-century houses along the Prinsengracht and Keizersgracht with 225 unique rooms, fully renovated in 2016.
quote: Set within 25 interlinked 17th and 18th century canal houses ... located along the famous Prinsengracht and Keizersgracht canals and offers 225 unique guest rooms ... A full renovation was completed in 2016

claim: Pulitzer Amsterdam 2026 nightly rates start around EUR 285-307 (roughly $285-349).
quote: Pulitzer Amsterdam from $285 ... Rates from EUR307 ... Starting from $349 per night

claim: The Hoxton Amsterdam (opened 2015) occupies five 17th-century canal houses on the Herengracht - once a 17th-century mayor's residence - within the UNESCO-protected Canal Ring, with 111 rooms.
quote: made up of five 17th-century canal houses and overlooks two canals on the Herengracht. It was once the residence of the mayor in the 17th century and is set within the UNESCO-protected Canal Ring ... 111 rooms

claim: Hotel Madame Reve is featured by Mr & Mrs Smith as a 1st-arrondissement boutique hotel.
quote: Hotel Madame Reve | 1st Arrondissement boutique hotel

claim: Maison Saintonge in the Marais (3rd) has a pastel candy-shop aesthetic with exposed beams, stone walls and vintage furniture; rates roughly €179-€500.
quote: Maison Saintonge - Marais (3rd) Pastel, candy-shop aesthetic with "exposed beams, stone walls, vintage furniture." Sweet shop in lobby. €179-€500
